scope: Review-only v4 four-field Dots Template superseding the prior candidate after the user's explicit rejection of Dots clothing. It retains only the former no-clothing recipes; every selected output remains pending art approval.

descriptionByLanguage.en: A blue short-pile plush orb with black oval eyes and over-ear headphones. It has no visible mouth or limbs.
descriptionByLanguage.zh-CN: 蓝色短绒圆球角色，佩戴包耳式耳机，黑色椭圆眼睛，无嘴与肢体。

artApproval.scope: Four-field Dots review candidate only. The user rejected Dots clothing; this manifest removes clothing options/layers and preserves only exact unclothed recipes. No art approval is implied.

identitySemanticsByLanguage.en: One Dots character with a continuous plush body and two simple eyes. No arms, hands, legs, feet, mouth, screen face, props, or background.
identitySemanticsByLanguage.zh-CN: 单个连续绒面身体、两只简洁眼睛的 Dots 角色。无手臂、手、腿、脚、嘴、屏幕脸、道具或背景。

semanticByLanguage.en: a round plush orb-shaped Dots body
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 圆球形绒面 Dots 身体

semanticByLanguage.en: a low continuous three-lobed plush cloud Dots body
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 低矮连续、三处圆润起伏的云团绒面 Dots 身体

semanticByLanguage.en: two simple glossy black upright oval eyes
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 两只简洁、带高光的黑色竖椭圆眼

semanticByLanguage.en: two gently curved closed-eye marks as a static expression
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 两道柔和弯曲的闭眼线，作为静态表情

semanticByLanguage.en: a black headband with violet over-ear headphone cups
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 黑色头带与紫色包耳式耳罩

semanticByLanguage.en: round black-framed glasses aligned over the eyes
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 对齐眼睛位置的黑色圆框眼镜

semanticByLanguage.en: a soft ivory plush chef toque fitted to the crown, with no head or body added
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 贴合头顶的柔软象牙白绒面厨师帽，不增加头部或身体

semanticByLanguage.en: wide black opaque oval sunglasses fitted across the open eyes
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 贴合睁眼位置的黑色不透明宽椭圆墨镜

semanticByLanguage.en: black-framed translucent cyan cyber glasses fitted over the eyes so the eye marks remain visible
semanticByLanguage.zh-CN: 贴合眼睛且保留眼睛可见的黑框半透明青色赛博眼镜

messageByLanguage.en: These over-ear cups and headband are registered for the round orb silhouette. Choose the cloud with no accessory or round glasses, or choose the orb to keep the headphones.
messageByLanguage.zh-CN: 这副包耳耳罩与头带仅按圆球轮廓制作。云团可选择无配饰或圆框眼镜；若要耳机，请切换为圆球。

messageByLanguage.en: The chef toque layer is fitted to the round orb only. Choose Orb for this accessory, or choose the cloud with another registered accessory.
messageByLanguage.zh-CN: 厨师帽图层仅按圆球轮廓适配。若要此配饰请切换圆球；云团可改用其他已登记配饰。

messageByLanguage.en: The black cool sunglasses layer is fitted to the round orb only. Choose Orb for this accessory, or choose the cloud with another registered accessory.
messageByLanguage.zh-CN: 黑色酷墨镜图层仅按圆球轮廓适配。若要此配饰请切换圆球；云团可改用其他已登记配饰。

messageByLanguage.en: The cyber glasses layer is fitted to the round orb only. Choose Orb for this accessory, or choose the cloud with another registered accessory.
messageByLanguage.zh-CN: 赛博眼镜图层仅按圆球轮廓适配。若要此配饰请切换圆球；云团可改用其他已登记配饰。

messageByLanguage.en: The opaque dark lenses conceal the closed-eye expression. Choose open eyes or another accessory.
messageByLanguage.zh-CN: 深色不透明镜片会遮住闭眼表情。请选择睁眼或其他配饰。
